verdict.rationale: Mercury documents organization approval policies: payment requests require approval per those policies [mercury-docs-55], optional approval controls on payments [mercury-docs-53], and dashboard sign-off before funds are released [mercury-docs-47]. It also advertises granular user permissions and approvals [mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-38], and its marketing claims built-in permissions let an accountant make payments in one click [mercury-docs-11, mercury-docs-3]. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring approver roles and policy rules, documentation of the one-click approve-and-send flow beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
